levels.note: population persists, reproduces, holds homeostasis and matter keeps cycling — the living subsystem is self-sustaining.
individuals differentiated into multiple species and interacted — through predation and/or cooperation.
agents used environmental information to steer (gradient foraging, hazard response), sustained a communication/culture channel, and selection improved their payoff across the run.

synthesis.chain: Matter loops (L0) cycle; life (L1) is emergent; interaction (L2) is emergent; cognition (L3) is emergent. The causal ladder holds: L1 requires L0, L2 requires L1's persistent population, and L3 requires L2's structured population — each rung is a prerequisite that the run either satisfies or fails.
